project.name: hackfront
project.objective: Build an evidence-grounded engineering memory system that reconstructs why code is the way it is from temporal relationships across source artifacts.

lifecycle.next_action: Review completed work and choose the next bounded outcome.

approval.reason: Owner approved spec incl. benchmark FR-21..23, AC-16..18 in chat 2026-10-23

assumptions.text: ING-2 uses the GitHub REST API for commit history and hosted pull-request records (including reviews and comments); a local-clone adapter can be added if later operational requirements need it.

decisions.title: First-slice Git and pull-request coverage
decisions.text: The first ingestion slice must ingest both Git history and hosted pull-request metadata. GitHub is the provisional hosted provider based on repository context; the route for obtaining commit history (local clone or provider API) remains an implementation detail to confirm.

decisions.title: MVP scope expanded to agent + UI
decisions.text: Owner approved in chat (2026-10-15) extending the product to ingestion->graph->agent->UI with Azure and Sarvam LLM providers, uv for Python, and delegated architecture decisions to the implementer. Non-goals 'agent/UI' removed from SPEC.

decisions.title: Text-reference edges and harness design
decisions.text: Cross-source links come only from explicit identifiers in text (Jira keys of configured projects, GitHub PR/commit URLs, Slack permalinks) as REFERENCES edges with origin=text. Agent never writes Cypher: fixed read-only tools, validated args, EXPLAIN self-check, verified citations. See docs/architecture.md.

decisions.title: Use the owner's Next.js workbench as the product UI
decisions.text: The owner's existing UI (web/) is the product UI; the interim vanilla page is removed. Backend gains claim-level investigations with verbatim-quote verification, blame from ingested patches, and workbench endpoints (docs/workbench-api.md). The UI was found late and copied in rather than merged, because git denied the merge as a shared-resource change.

decisions.title: Build our own benchmark
decisions.text: No organizer dataset or judge exists. Build own benchmark per data/EVAL_PLAN.md: same data/LLM/budget, systems B0 LLM-only, B1 vector RAG, S- no verifier, S full; tiers A/B/C + traps; 5 metrics; dev/test split. Added FR-21..23, AC-16..18.
